import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
d = pd.read_pickle('nube.pkl')
nc = pd.read_pickle('nc.pkl')
pg = pd.read_pickle('pagos.pkl')

d = d[d['ANULADO'] == 'NO'].copy()
d['fecha'] = pd.to_datetime(d['FECHA'])
d['ruc'] = d['RUC'].astype(str).str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True).str.zfill(11)
d['neto'] = d['SUMA_NETO_VTA'].astype(float)
d['cant'] = d['SUMA_CANTIDAD'].astype(float)
d['tdoc'] = d['TIPO DOCUMENTO']
d['bonif'] = d['TIPO DE VENTA'] == 'BONIFICADO'
d['linea'] = d['LINEA'].fillna('SIN LINEA')

# ---- NC classification: refacturación?
nc['ruc'] = nc['RUC'].astype(str).str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True).str.zfill(11)
nc['fecha'] = pd.to_datetime(nc['FECHA EMISION'], dayfirst=True, errors='coerce')
nc['monto'] = nc['IMPORTE NOTA DE CREDITO'].astype(float)
facts = d[d['tdoc'] == 'FACTURA'].groupby(['ruc', 'NRO DOCUMENTO']).agg(f=('fecha', 'min'), t=('neto', 'sum')).reset_index()
ADMIN = {'REFACTURACION', 'CAMBIO DE GUIA', 'ERROR EN VENTA', 'PEDIDO DUPLICADO'}
def es_refact(r):
    if str(r['MOTIVO']).strip() in ('NC ANULADA', 'ANULADO'):
        return True
    if str(r['DESCRIPCION']).strip().upper() in ADMIN:
        return True
    if str(r['MOTIVO']).startswith('ANULACION') or str(r['MOTIVO']) == 'PEDIDO ANULADO':
        c = facts[(facts.ruc == r.ruc) & (facts.NRO_DOC if False else True)]
        c = c[(c.f >= r.fecha - pd.Timedelta(days=3)) & (c.f <= r.fecha + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) & (c['NRO DOCUMENTO'] != r['FACTURA'])]
        net_sin_igv = r.monto / 1.18
        return bool(((c.t >= 0.5 * net_sin_igv) & (c.t <= 1.5 * net_sin_igv)).any())
    return False
nc['refact'] = nc.apply(es_refact, axis=1)
refact_docs = set(nc.loc[nc.refact, 'NOTA DE CREDITO'])
motivo = nc.set_index('NOTA DE CREDITO')['MOTIVO'].to_dict()
d['refact'] = (d['tdoc'] == 'NOTA DE CREDITO') & d['NRO DOCUMENTO'].isin(refact_docs)
d['motivo_nc'] = np.where(d['tdoc'] == 'NOTA DE CREDITO', d['NRO DOCUMENTO'].map(motivo), None)
print('NC total', round(nc.monto.sum()), 'refact', round(nc.loc[nc.refact, 'monto'].sum()), 'n', nc.refact.sum())
print(nc.groupby(['MOTIVO', 'refact'])['monto'].agg(['count', 'sum']).round(0))

d['q'] = d['fecha'].dt.to_period('Q')
d['m'] = d['fecha'].dt.to_period('M')
venta = d[d['tdoc'] != 'NOTA DE CREDITO']
ncs = d[d['tdoc'] == 'NOTA DE CREDITO']

# ---- Ranking window: last closed quarter + previous (6 months)
CORTE = pd.Period('2026Q3')
VENT = [CORTE - 1, CORTE]
LINEAS_ACTIVAS = sorted(set(venta[(venta.q.isin(VENT)) & (~venta.bonif) & (venta.neto > 0)].linea) - {'DESCUENTO'})

def scores(win_q, label):
    w = d[d.q.isin(win_q)]
    wv = w[(w.tdoc != 'NOTA DE CREDITO')]
    wn = w[(w.tdoc == 'NOTA DE CREDITO')]
    g = pd.DataFrame(index=sorted(set(wv.ruc)))
    g['venta_bruta'] = wv.groupby('ruc').neto.sum()
    g['nc_total'] = -wn.groupby('ruc').neto.sum()
    g['nc_penal'] = -wn[~wn.refact].groupby('ruc').neto.sum()
    g = g.fillna(0)
    g['venta_neta'] = g.venta_bruta - g.nc_total
    meses = len(win_q) * 3
    g['meses_compra'] = wv[~wv.bonif].groupby('ruc').m.nunique()
    g['pedidos'] = wv[~wv.bonif].groupby('ruc')['NRO DOCUMENTO'].nunique()
    g['lineas'] = wv[(~wv.bonif) & (wv.neto > 0)].groupby('ruc').linea.nunique()
    g['skus'] = wv[(~wv.bonif) & (wv.neto > 0)].groupby('ruc')['COD PROD'].nunique()
    g = g.fillna(0)
    g = g[g.venta_bruta > 0]
    g['tasa_dev'] = (g.nc_penal / g.venta_bruta).clip(0, 1)
    cred = wv.groupby('ruc')['CONDICION VENTA'].apply(lambda s: (s == 'CREDITO').any())
    g['credito'] = cred.reindex(g.index).fillna(False)
    p = pg.copy(); p['ruc'] = p.ruc.astype(str).str.zfill(11)
    p = p.set_index('ruc')
    g['pct_puntual'] = pd.to_numeric(p.pct_puntual, errors='coerce').reindex(g.index)
    g['atraso_pond'] = pd.to_numeric(p.atraso_pond, errors='coerce').reindex(g.index)
    has = g.atraso_pond.notna()
    g.loc[has, 'pct_puntual'] = g.loc[has, 'pct_puntual'].fillna(0)
    # scores 0-100
    g['s_vol'] = g.venta_neta.clip(lower=0).rank(pct=True) * 100
    g['s_pago'] = np.where(has, 0.6 * g.pct_puntual + 0.4 * (100 - (g.atraso_pond.clip(0, 60) / 60 * 100)),
                           np.where(g.credito, 50, 100))
    g['s_frec'] = (g.meses_compra / meses).clip(0, 1) * 100
    g['s_mix'] = 0.5 * g.lineas.rank(pct=True) * 100 + 0.5 * g.skus.rank(pct=True) * 100
    g['s_dev'] = (100 - g.tasa_dev / 0.20 * 100).clip(0, 100)
    W = dict(s_vol=.30, s_pago=.25, s_frec=.15, s_mix=.15, s_dev=.15)
    g['puntaje'] = sum(g[k] * v for k, v in W.items())
    g['categoria'] = np.select([g.puntaje >= 70, g.puntaje >= 50], ['ORO', 'PLATA'], 'BRONCE')
    g['periodo'] = label
    return g

cur = scores(VENT, '2026T2-T3')
prev = scores([CORTE - 3, CORTE - 2], '2025T4-2026T1')
print(cur.categoria.value_counts(), cur.groupby('categoria').venta_neta.sum().round(0))
print(prev.categoria.value_counts())
cur.to_pickle('cur.pkl'); prev.to_pickle('prev.pkl'); d.to_pickle('d.pkl')
print(cur[['s_vol','s_pago','s_frec','s_mix','s_dev','puntaje']].describe().round(1))

d = pd.read_pickle('d.pkl'); cur = pd.read_pickle('cur.pkl'); prev = pd.read_pickle('prev.pkl')
Q12 = [pd.Period(x) for x in ['2025Q4', '2026Q1', '2026Q2', '2026Q3']]
v = d[d.tdoc != 'NOTA DE CREDITO']; n = d[d.tdoc == 'NOTA DE CREDITO']
r2 = lambda x: round(float(x), 2)

# monthly
m = d.groupby('m').apply(lambda g: pd.Series({
    'bruta': g[g.tdoc != 'NOTA DE CREDITO'].neto.sum(), 'nc': -g[g.tdoc == 'NOTA DE CREDITO'].neto.sum(),
    'clientes': g[g.tdoc != 'NOTA DE CREDITO'].ruc.nunique()}))
m['neta'] = m.bruta - m.nc
mensual = [dict(mes=str(k), bruta=r2(r.bruta), nc=r2(r.nc), neta=r2(r.neta), clientes=int(r.clientes)) for k, r in m.iterrows()]

w = d[d.q.isin(Q12)]
wv = w[w.tdoc != 'NOTA DE CREDITO']
q = d.groupby(['q']).neto.sum()
kpi = dict(
    venta_neta_12m=r2(w.neto.sum()), venta_bruta_12m=r2(wv.neto.sum()),
    nc_12m=r2(-w[w.tdoc == 'NOTA DE CREDITO'].neto.sum()),
    q3=r2(q[pd.Period('2026Q3')]), q2=r2(q[pd.Period('2026Q2')]),
    q4_parcial=r2(q[pd.Period('2026Q4')]),
    clientes_12m=int(wv.ruc.nunique()), pedidos_12m=int(wv['NRO DOCUMENTO'].nunique()),
    skus_12m=int(wv[~wv.bonif]['COD PROD'].nunique()))
kpi['ticket'] = r2(kpi['venta_bruta_12m'] / kpi['pedidos_12m'])

# lines (net, 12m) + growth Q3 vs Q2
L = w.groupby('linea').agg(neta=('neto', 'sum'), clientes=('ruc', 'nunique'), skus=('COD PROD', 'nunique'))
lq = d[d.q.isin([pd.Period('2026Q2'), pd.Period('2026Q3')])].groupby(['linea', 'q']).neto.sum().unstack().fillna(0)
L = L.join(lq).fillna(0); L = L[L.index != 'DESCUENTO'].sort_values('neta', ascending=False)
tot = L.neta.sum()
lineas = [dict(linea=k, neta=r2(r.neta), share=r2(r.neta / tot * 100), clientes=int(r.clientes), skus=int(r.skus),
               q2=r2(r[pd.Period('2026Q2')]), q3=r2(r[pd.Period('2026Q3')])) for k, r in L.iterrows()]

# products (net 12m)
P = w[w.linea != 'DESCUENTO'].groupby(['COD PROD']).agg(producto=('PRODUCTO', 'first'), linea=('linea', 'first'), neta=('neto', 'sum'),
    cant=('cant', 'sum'), clientes=('ruc', 'nunique'))
P = P[P.neta > 0].sort_values('neta', ascending=False)
P['share_total'] = P.neta / P.neta.sum() * 100
P['share_linea'] = P.neta / P.groupby('linea').neta.transform('sum') * 100
P['rank_total'] = np.arange(1, len(P) + 1)
P['rank_linea'] = P.groupby('linea').neta.rank(ascending=False, method='first').astype(int)
# reposición: median days between purchases by same client
vv = v[(~v.bonif) & (v.neto > 0)][['COD PROD', 'ruc', 'fecha']].drop_duplicates().sort_values('fecha')
vv['gap'] = vv.groupby(['COD PROD', 'ruc']).fecha.diff().dt.days
rep = vv[vv.gap > 3].groupby('COD PROD').gap.median()
recompra = vv.groupby(['COD PROD', 'ruc']).size().gt(1).groupby('COD PROD').mean() * 100

productos = [dict(cod=k, producto=r.producto, linea=r.linea, neta=r2(r.neta), cant=int(r.cant), clientes=int(r.clientes),
                  share_total=r2(r.share_total), share_linea=r2(r.share_linea), rank_total=int(r.rank_total), rank_linea=int(r.rank_linea),
                  ciclo_dias=None if pd.isna(r.ciclo_dias) else int(r.ciclo_dias),
                  pct_recompra=None if pd.isna(r.pct_recompra) else round(float(r.pct_recompra))) for k, r in P.iterrows()]
